non_additive_warning: Each stage counts a different population with its own identity basis. Stages overlap and are not a reconciled funnel; never add or subtract them unless a stage says how.
method: Machine-reconciled from registry/discovery/*.json records. Static decisions are keyed by exact (source repository, pin, canonical path) and the latest dated ledger wins; 113 keys were reviewed more than once and none of those repeats conflict. Narrative historical totals (5,508 terminal decisions incl. 195 older static_decision-only records) are preserved in CURATION_QUEUE.md and are not replaced.
